summary: Defines how to compute a digest (hash) of an XML document so that the result depends on its content and structure, not on surface differences in how the text is written. Two XML documents that mean the same thing then produce the same hash. It is an informational memo.

eli5.summary: Two people might write the same sentence with different spacing. This gives a way to boil an XML file down to a fingerprint that stays the same even if the spacing or style differs.
